judgment.rationale: The report supplies concrete French/English queries and screenshots; the maintainer confirms programs already account for localization while folders and settings use different direct queries.
evidence: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/34165 reports 0.81.1 and the Downloads/téléchargements query difference, plus missing screen-resolution settings.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/34165#issuecomment-2269284300 explicitly distinguishes program localization from folder/settings queries.
The live issue is open and unassigned, with no linked fix events or exact-number PR search matches.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the two examples on a French-language system, attribute each result to its provider, and scope localized/neutral aliases without promising full Windows Search parity.

fix_assessment.rationale: Provider-specific alias coverage is an applicable code-change hypothesis supported by the maintainer's response. No existing fix attempt for this issue was identified.

proposed_fixes.title: Match localized and neutral aliases for known folders and settings
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: folder and Windows Settings result providers do not expose the same localized/neutral query aliases as the program provider, so a localized shell display name or translated settings term cannot match the available provider metadata.
plan: On French Windows, identify whether Downloads is returned by Microsoft.Plugin.Indexer or Microsoft.Plugin.Folder and inspect its searchable metadata; separately inspect the WindowsSettings result for screen resolution.
Reuse the shell display-name mechanism in src/modules/launcher/Wox.Plugin/Common/ShellLocalization.cs for appropriate known-folder aliases while preserving the canonical path used for activation.

In src/modules/launcher/Plugins/Microsoft.PowerToys.Run.Plugin.WindowsSettings, extend the relevant localized name/alias catalog and matching rather than translating arbitrary paths or promising every Windows Search result.
Deduplicate results across aliases and add provider tests for French accented queries, English aliases, case handling and unchanged activation targets.
verification: On French Windows, both téléchargements and downloads must resolve to the same actual Downloads location when that provider supports known-folder discovery.
The translated screen-resolution query must return the appropriate Settings destination; launching it must open the intended page.
Verify English Windows, relocated Downloads, accented/case variants and duplicate-result suppression.

confidence.rationale: The maintainer response supports the provider-coverage explanation; the current failing provider and alias data still need a locale-specific comparison.

issue_context.summary: A bilingual French/English user finds Downloads and screen-resolution settings with Windows Search but not the corresponding localized queries in PowerToys Run.
known_information: The Downloads query works as downloads but not téléchargements on the reported system.
The report includes comparison screenshots for both folders and screen-resolution settings.
A maintainer says programs already account for the issue, unlike the more directly queried folders and settings.
No assignee or linked implementation is present.
inferences: The two examples likely need different provider/catalog changes rather than a single global query translation.
Bilingual aliases can improve the reported cases without establishing that Run must match all Windows Search behavior.
issue_context.analysis: Enough concrete examples exist for maintainer-side locale testing. Do not ask for logs or repeat the supplied screenshots; first identify the provider and missing alias in the current build.
initial_investigation: Read the full report, its sole maintainer comment and the empty cross-reference timeline.
Current WindowsSettings Main.Query filters its catalog by names/areas; it is not a pass-through query to Windows Search.
Current ShellLocalization.GetLocalizedName retrieves localized shell display names and caches them, providing an existing mechanism to evaluate for folder aliases.
Direct issue-number PR search found no match; this does not prove no other localization work exists.

information_gaps.information: Current provider attribution and alias coverage for each of the two supplied French queries.
information_gaps.why_needed: Selects a folder metadata change versus a Settings catalog/matching change.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Maintainer: reproduce on French Windows, isolate the relevant Run plugins, and inspect result-provider metadata for the supplied queries.

actions.label: Compare French known-folder and settings queries

reproduce.title: French and English query aliases in PowerToys Run
prerequisites: A Windows user profile with French display language and the normal Downloads known folder.
Run folder/indexing and Windows Settings plugins enabled; record which provider supplies each result.
steps: Compare téléchargements and downloads in Windows Search and PowerToys Run, recording whether each returns the same Downloads location.
Repeat with the French screen-resolution term used by Windows Settings and inspect the matching Settings catalog entry.
Isolate relevant plugins to determine which provider is missing each result.
Compare localized display names, canonical paths and available alternate-name metadata before choosing a patch.
reproduce.expected_result: The scoped folder and settings examples should resolve through supported localized/neutral aliases and activate the correct destination; full Windows Search parity is not assumed.
